class TrainingCandidateSampler:
    def __init__(self, user_train, count=64):
        self.count = count
        self.rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
        self.catalog = np.asarray(
            sorted({int(i) for h in user_train.values() for i in h if int(i) > 0}),
            dtype=np.int64,
        )
        self.blocked = {}
        for user, history in user_train.items():
            items = np.asarray(sorted(set(history)), dtype=np.int64)
            items = items[items > 0]
            indices = np.searchsorted(self.catalog, items)
            self.blocked[user] = indices
        self.skipped_positions = 0
        self.processed_positions = 0
        self.candidate_counts = defaultdict(int)
        self.sampling_seconds = 0.0
        self._verify_fixture()

    @staticmethod
    def _map_ranks(ranks, blocked):
        # Removing sorted blocked indices shifts every later eligible index.
        offsets = blocked - np.arange(blocked.size, dtype=np.int64)
        return ranks + np.searchsorted(offsets, ranks, side="right")

    @classmethod
    def _verify_fixture(cls):
        rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
        catalog = np.asarray([2, 5, 9, 12, 20, 31])
        blocked = np.asarray([0, 2, 5])
        eligible = np.asarray([5, 12, 20])
        mapped = catalog[cls._map_ranks(np.arange(3), blocked)]
        if not np.array_equal(mapped, eligible):
            raise RuntimeError("Eligible-rank mapping fixture failed")
        for _ in range(16):
            draws = catalog[cls._map_ranks(rng.choice(3, 2, replace=False), blocked)]
            if len(set(draws.tolist())) != 2 or not np.isin(draws, eligible).all():
                raise RuntimeError("Unique-candidate fixture failed")

    def sample(self, batch_users, sequence, positive):
        import time

        started = time.perf_counter()
        valid = (sequence != 0) & (positive != 0)
        rows, columns = np.nonzero(valid)
        negatives = np.zeros((rows.size, self.count), dtype=np.int64)
        keep = np.zeros(rows.size, dtype=bool)
        for index, (row, column) in enumerate(zip(rows, columns)):
            blocked = self.blocked[int(batch_users[row])]
            target = int(positive[row, column])
            target_index = int(np.searchsorted(self.catalog, target))
            if (target_index >= self.catalog.size
                    or self.catalog[target_index] != target):
                raise RuntimeError("Training target absent from training catalog")
            membership = int(np.searchsorted(blocked, target_index))
            if membership >= blocked.size or blocked[membership] != target_index:
                raise RuntimeError("Target missing from sampled user's training history")
            available = self.catalog.size - blocked.size
            k = min(self.count, available)
            if k == 0:
                self.skipped_positions += 1
                continue
            ranks = self.rng.choice(available, size=k, replace=False)
            negatives[index, :k] = self.catalog[self._map_ranks(ranks, blocked)]
            keep[index] = True
            self.processed_positions += 1
            self.candidate_counts[k + 1] += 1
        self.sampling_seconds += time.perf_counter() - started
        return valid, keep, negatives[keep]


def candidate_ce_backward(model, seq, pos, valid, keep, negatives):
    device = seq.device
    keep_t = torch.as_tensor(keep, dtype=torch.bool, device=device)
    n = int(keep.sum())
    if n == 0:
        return 0.0
    valid_t = torch.as_tensor(valid, dtype=torch.bool, device=device)
    features = model.log2feats(seq)[valid_t][keep_t]
    targets = pos[valid_t][keep_t]
    # Release each sampled-embedding graph before backpropagating through the
    # recurrent network once. This is exactly the valid-position mean reduction.
    score_features = features.detach().requires_grad_(True)
    total = 0.0
    for start in range(0, n, 512):
        end = min(start + 512, n)
        sampled = torch.as_tensor(negatives[start:end], device=device)
        candidates = torch.cat((targets[start:end, None], sampled), dim=-1)
        logits = model.predict_score(score_features[start:end], candidates).float()
        logits = logits.masked_fill(candidates.eq(0), float("-inf"))
        losses = torch.logsumexp(logits, dim=-1) - logits[:, 0]
        loss = losses.sum() / n
        loss.backward()
        total += float(loss.detach())
    features.backward(score_features.grad)
    return total
